propositions: The outbound mapper injects the assignee resolver via attribute assignment, which fails silently if the attribute cannot be set, causing all downstream resolutions to degrade to non-authoritative
The attribute-injection pattern is invisible to the type checker and requires type: ignore comments, making the dependency invisible in the contract
The neutral OutboundMapper.resolve_assignee port and its two implementers (Cloud and DC) need to accept an explicit assignee_resolver keyword parameter instead of discovering it via getattr
The resolver must be threaded explicitly from compute_update_fields through diff_canonical_fields to the resolve_assignee call site, replacing the try/except attribute-injection block
DC's constructor-bound resolver and the core's per-issue resolver must coexist, with explicit parameters taking precedence over constructor-supplied ones to preserve current overwrite semantics
All four _assignee_resolver attribute references and all getattr discovery calls must be removed, and type: ignore[attr-defined] comments deleted
